items.title: #SaveMaryJane: A cause worth fighting for during the glorious days of social media
items.description: In 2015, citizens all over the world campaigned to stop the execution of Mary Jane Veloso — a time when social media was a force for social good

items.title: China ‘hinders’ PH resupply mission to Ayungin Shoal
items.description: The PCG says a Chinese naval warship issued a radio challenge, warning it would take 'compulsory measures' to prevent the mission, while Chinese coast guard and maritime militia vessels were in the vicinity of Ayungin Shoal

items.title: FACT CHECK: No basis to claim that Villar siblings, Padilla face arrest to force VP Sara’s ouster
items.description: Graft complaints against the Villars exist, but these are related to a water utility deal, not to Duterte's impeachment. Padilla, meanwhile, faces an obstruction of justice complaint over Dela Rosa’s escape.

items.title: PAL to launch nonstop Manila flights to Delhi, Mumbai in December 2026
items.description: Delhi is India’s capital and a gateway to northern India, while Mumbai is the country’s financial and commercial center

items.title: Why Sara Duterte ally is taking impeachment vote threshold fight to SC
items.description: 'The Senate possesses the power to try and decide. It does not possess the power to determine its own constitutional voting threshold,' says lawyer and former executive secretary Vic Rodriguez

items.title: Gilas Women earn shot at Asian Games 3×3 gold; Gilas Men drop to bronze match
items.description: Gilas Women stay unbeaten after a low-scoring win over Thailand in the semifinals and assure the Philippines its first-ever 3x3 basketball medal in the Asian Games

items.title: ‘Filipiñana’ team appeals for support as lead star Jorrybell Agoto battles cancer
items.description: Just over a week after Filipiñana’ earned the Philippines’ Oscar nod, lead actress Jorrybell Agoto is now in critical care following lung surgery

items.title: Pope Leo heads to France with AI, apologies for clergy abuse on agenda
items.description: Pope Leo is likely to draw large crowds on the September 25 to 28 visit, which includes stops in Paris, at the famed Catholic shrine in Lourdes, and in a city on the German border central to the founding of the EU

items.title: AI might run your first job interview as JobStreet launches new hiring tools
items.description: ‘AI is there to support, but the decision is always on the employer and on the candidate. What AI will do is give you recommendations,’ JobStreet managing director Dannah Majarocon tells Rappler

items.title: Allies unite behind Saudi Arabia as Houthis step up attacks
items.description: The Houthis launch strikes on the Saudi-backed government in Yemen and repeatedly fire into Saudi Arabia, disrupting oil flows from the world’s largest energy exporter, as part of a wider Middle East war

items.title: Trillanes sought as witness on Duterte wealth allegations
items.description: They want him questioned over alleged P181.6-M transactions involving Sara Duterte and her family.

items.title: Marcos signs law postponing 2026 barangay, SK elections
items.description: The newly approved law moved the elections to the first Monday of November 2028, and extended the terms of village officers from four to five years.

items.title: Marcos grants absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso
items.description: This is after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed an executive clemency for Veloso, giving her a clean slate.

items.title: DOE sees P8 diesel price rollback by end-September
items.description: The P8 per liter rollback on diesel, P6 on kerosene and P0.90 in gasoline, are expected next week.

items.title: ‘Queenie’ maintains strength, may become typhoon by Sunday
items.description: Tropical Storm Queenie maintained its strength as it moved northwestward over the Philippine Sea, PAGASA said Friday morning.

items.title: DICT chief backs bill requiring legislative franchises for social media platforms
items.description: Information and Communications Technology Chief Henry Aguda has expressed his support for a proposed bill in the House of Representatives that would require social media sites and online platforms to secure a legislative franchise to operate in the Philippines.

items.title: House wraps up budget talks on more agencies
items.description: Budget deliberations for fiscal year 2027 of at least seven more agencies have been terminated by the House of Representatives, which is expected to finish such hearings this week before the General Appropriations Bill is approved on second reading early next month.

items.title: PSA: Bangsamoro polls random manual audit 99.9% accurate
items.description: The Random Manual Audit conducted for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao parliamentary election yielded an overall accuracy rate of 99.99561 percent, based on the results from all 21 BARMM sample clustered precincts audited as of Sept. 23, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority.

items.title: Warships from ASEAN, other states sail in West Philippine Sea
items.description: Eleven warships from Association of Southeast Asian nations member states and other partner nations sailed the waters of the West Philippine Sea  on Wednesday as part of this year’s ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting-Plus  Experts’ Working Group on Maritime Security.

items.title: Monsod criticizes senators over stand on vote threshold
items.description: A framer of the 1987 Constitution called out Senators Alan Peter Cayetano and Camille Villar, who objected to the proposal to lower the number of votes needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial.
